name: Ruins of Feathermoon
summary: In the current era of 25 ADP, the island base of Sardor Isle stands intact as Feathermoon Stronghold, the primary sentinel bastion of the night elves along the coast of Feralas. Although ancient elven remnants pepper the surrounding wilds, the active bastion is fully fortified against mainland threats and encroaching sea creatures. The stronghold remains a vital haven for the Alliance in southern Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Wilds
sections.body: Situated safely across the strait on Sardor Isle, the night elven fortification known as Feathermoon Stronghold keeps watch over the primeval wilderness of Feralas. While ancient Highborne ruins litter the forest and coastline, this fortress was raised by the Sentinels to project night elven authority and safeguard their borders against the Gordunni ogres, foul satyrs, and the emerging naga swarming nearby shores. Within its moon-blessed towers, Shandris Feathermoon directs military operations across the southern forests.

sections.title: Threats Across the Water
sections.body: Though protected by the ocean, the outpost faces mounting tension. Across the waves on the mainland, the Hatecrest naga have begun infesting the beaches and sea caves, slithering ever closer to the island's shores. The Sentinels maintain constant vigil from their towers and ships, prepared to defend Sardor Isle from any surprise coastal assault launched from the deep trenches of the Great Sea.

faq.q: Are the ruins of Feathermoon Stronghold currently destroyed?
faq.answer: No. In 25 ADP, Feathermoon Stronghold is completely intact and operational on Sardor Isle. It serves as the primary military headquarters for General Shandris Feathermoon and the Sentinels guarding Feralas.
It is situated on Sardor Isle, a large island off the southwestern coast of Feralas. Travelers reach it via a night elven coastal ferry from the mainland shore.
General Shandris Feathermoon commands the outpost. She is the adopted daughter of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and the supreme military commander of the Sentinel army.

The immediate threat comes from the Hatecrest naga creeping along the Feralas coast and nearby shoals. Further inland, the outpost must keep watch over aggressive Gordunni ogres, Woodpaw gnolls, and the sinister remnants lurking around the ancient city of Eldre'Thalas.

angles.text: Feathermoon Stronghold serves as the Alliance's lone secure outpost in western Feralas, offering shelter, flight masters, and supply lines deep within hostile territory.
For night elf Sentinels and druids, the base represents the vigilance of Darnassus, holding sacred watch over the tainted ruins and forests of their ancestral homeland.
